correctness.rationale: The Zak Fourier representation follows from a signed difference of two elementary rational Fourier transforms; all Fourier terms are absolutely summable. The Zak zeros are equivalent to unit-circle zeros of the explicit real cubic with no vanishing denominators. The exact coefficient obstruction eliminates nonreal roots except at frequency one half; the residual quadratic has strictly larger constant than its possible unimodular oscillation. Explicit z=±1 and boundary frequency factorizations exhaust the three zeros. The standalone checker reproduces the polynomial identities and sampled series agreement; full quantifiers are justified by algebra and strict inequalities, not sampling.

value.rationale: A complete two-variable zero-set classification valid across an unrestricted continuous dilation parameter for the smallest odd symmetric-pole Gabor window is an interpretable structural invariant. It determines all scalar cancellation points relevant to subsequent fiber-matrix problems without claiming the separate and unresolved full frame-set theorem. The claim is motivated by the explicit Zak polynomial and frame obstructions in the 2026 source, rather than by an arbitrary choice of isolated parameters.
